purpose: Record analytic source theorems and whether they have been converted into explicit residue-audit rules.
claim_boundary: This file records source leads and audit status. It does not by itself prove that the analytic residue is contained in the verified finite domain.

entries.title: On Graham's rearrangement conjecture
entries.reported_statement: For every alpha in (0,1), the conjecture is proved for subsets S of Z_p minus {0} with |S| <= p^(1-alpha) and |S| sufficiently large with respect to alpha. Combined with earlier results, this gives a complete resolution for all sufficiently large primes p.
entries.notes: This is the key source for a sufficiently-large-prime closure, but the repository still needs exact hypotheses, dependencies, and any effective finite threshold before using it as an audit rule.

entries.authors: Simone Costa; Stefano Della Fiore; Mattia Fontana; Lluís Vena
entries.title: Graham conjecture on small sets in abelian groups
entries.reported_statement: The paper states that the prime-field conjecture was recently proved for sufficiently large primes by Pham and Sauermann combined with earlier results, while the broader problem remains open for general abelian groups, even cyclic groups Z_k. It proves small-set sequenceability results in generic abelian groups.
entries.notes: Useful for positioning and possible future generalization to cyclic or abelian groups. It is not itself the prime-field finite-residue closure.

entries.title: Graham's rearrangement conjecture beyond the rectification barrier
entries.reported_statement: The conjecture is proved for prime-field sets of size |A| <= exp((log p)^(1/4)), improving the previous log(p)/loglog(p) bound.
entries.notes: Can replace or refine the script's default small_set_t_le_12 bookkeeping once exact dependencies and finite exceptions are audited.

entries.title: On Graham's rearrangement conjecture over F_2^n
entries.reported_statement: The abstract states, among other results, that for every group G, every subset S of G minus the identity with size at least |G|^(1-c) admits a valid ordering for an absolute constant c > 0.
entries.notes: Potential large-set coverage input, but the constant and effective implications for specific prime fields must be extracted before use in a proof audit.

required_next_step: Extract exact theorem statements, constants, thresholds, dependencies, and finite exceptions, then convert only source-backed ranges into scripts/reduction_residue_audit.py --range rules.
